prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Karthik bhai, Pooja S., Pooja didi, Kavita didi.
The chat covers 14/03/26, 8:15 pm to 14/03/26, 10:15 pm. It must have exactly 22 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
14/03/26, 9:26 pm - Pooja didi: Kavita didi, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
Fix these problems from your previous attempt:
- chat.txt: the LLM is unavailable (Gemini daily quota used up: You exceeded your current quota, please check your plan and billing details. For more information on this error, head to: https://aistudio.google.com/docs/rate-limits. To monitor your current usage, head to: https://ai.dev/rate-limit. 
* Quota exceeded for metric: generativelanguage.googleapis.com/generate_content_free_tier_requests, limit: 20, model: gemini-3.6-flash, description: Generate content requests per day limit exceeded on Free Tier. See https://aistudio.google.com/docs/rate-limits.
Please retry in 2h35m40.133639503s.)
text:
14/03/26, 8:15 pm - Karthik bhai: Hi everyone, kal ke target ka kya status hai?
14/03/26, 8:20 pm - Pooja S.: Maine saare daily reports send kar diye hain.
14/03/26, 8:25 pm - Kavita didi: Haan Karthik bhai, balance sheet bhi ready hai.
14/03/26, 8:32 pm - Pooja didi: Accha ek customer ka call aaya tha UPI refund ke liye.
14/03/26, 8:38 pm - Karthik bhai: Kaunsa customer? Kisi ne QR code scan karne ko bola kya?
14/03/26, 8:44 pm - Pooja didi: Haan, unhone bola ki PIN daal ke money receive hoga.
14/03/26, 8:50 pm - Kavita didi: Arey nahi, PIN sirf paise bhejne ke liye hota hai!
14/03/26, 8:55 pm - Pooja S.: Bilkul, receiver ko PIN nahi daalna padta. Fraud lag raha hai.
14/03/26, 9:02 pm - Karthik bhai: Did you share any OTP or click any link?
14/03/26, 9:10 pm - Pooja didi: Maine link par click karke test transfer kiya tha 5000 ka.
14/03/26, 9:15 pm - Kavita didi: Kya? Account se paise kat gaye kya?
14/03/26, 9:20 pm - Pooja S.: Yeh toh clear scam hai, turant bank helpline pe call karo.
14/03/26, 9:26 pm - Pooja didi: Kavita didi, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
14/03/26, 9:31 pm - Kavita didi: Record delete karne se money wapas nahi aayega Pooja.
14/03/26, 9:38 pm - Karthik bhai: Fraud reporting portal 1930 pe complaint log karo jaldi.
14/03/26, 9:44 pm - Pooja S.: Account ko temporary block karwana padega app se.
14/03/26, 9:50 pm - Pooja didi: Okay main cyber cell me issue register kar rahi hu.
14/03/26, 9:55 pm - Kavita didi: UTR number aur transaction screenshot save karke rakho.
14/03/26, 10:01 pm - Karthik bhai: Bank se baat hui kya kisi ki?
14/03/26, 10:07 pm - Pooja S.: Customer care ne freeze request process kar di hai.
14/03/26, 10:12 pm - Pooja didi: Haan, reference number mil gaya hai response me.
14/03/26, 10:15 pm - Kavita didi: Good, baaki updates kal morning me check karte hain.
